annotations.title: Find contracts coming up for re-bid

description:
The recompete pipeline: contracts ending in the next months with the incumbent, value,
    how they were bought (offers received, set-aside, vehicle) and the likeliest follow-on
    SAM.gov notice when one is posted, soonest ending first. Filters take names as people say
    them (VA, 541512, IT services, Leidos).

agency.description: An agency, bureau or office, e.g. "Army", "VA".
agency.title: Agency

company.description: An incumbent by name or UEI, e.g. "Leidos".
company.title: Company

min_value.description: Smallest current contract value in dollars (default 1,000,000).
min_value.title: Min Value

months.description: Contracts ending within this many months, 1-24 (default 12).
months.title: Months

naics.description: A NAICS code or industry words, e.g. "541512" or "janitorial".
naics.title: Naics

q.description: Words in the contract description, e.g. "help desk".
q.title: Q

set_aside.description: The set-aside of the current contract, e.g. "8(a)", "SDVOSB".
set_aside.title: Set Aside

name: recompetes
title: Find contracts coming up for re-bid
